en: A vintage postcard showing the interior of a large stone cathedral with tall arches, side chapels, and a prominent staircase leading up along the wall. There are wooden railings and choir stalls, religious statues, and dim light streaming in from tall windows. The entire front, including the image area, is heavily overprinted with handwritten correspondence. At the bottom, printed red text identifies the scene.
